title: Record step stages
statement: For $k$ work tapes, the record-step stages include state handling, position handling, copying, tape reading and skipping for each tape, tag reading, reading back and writing back indexed fields, halt and empty-cell clearing, fuel and probe operations, saving and seeking, reading and complementing, counter updates, restoration, state and tape writing, and verdict stages carrying a Boolean value. The indexed read-back and write-back stages range over $k+2$ positions.
